title: Neon Confessions
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: A memory-broker in the rain-soaked megacity of Kisima hunts the client who bought her own forgotten past — and finds a conspiracy wired into the city's dream network.
style: Hard-boiled first-person noir with neon-slick simile. Short punchy sentences, long neon descents. Cyberpunk grit.
characters: Kali — memory-broker, ex-cop, haunted; The Archivist — faceless buyer of stolen lives.
setting: Kisima, a vertical African megacity, 2099. Rain always. Neon always.
notes: Start in Kali's cramped office above a noodle stall. A client plays her a memory that is hers but she has no recall of. Cold open, high stakes.
